mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.name, m.gender, m.birthday, m.nickname, m.email, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.grade_id, g.name as grade_name, g.symbol as grade_symbol, m.profile, m.point, m.role FROM member m JOIN grade g ON m.grade_id = g.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.gender, m.birthday, m.nickname, m.email, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.grade_id, g.name as grade_name, g.symbol as grade_symbol, m.profile, m.point, m.role FROM member m JOIN grade g ON m.grade_id = g.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.id = #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.gender, m.birthday, m.nickname, m.email, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.grade_id, g.name as grade_name, g.symbol as grade_symbol, m.profile, m.point, m.role FROM member m JOIN grade g ON m.grade_id = g.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.gender, m.birthday, m.nickname, m.email, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.grade_id, g.name as grade_name, g.symbol as grade_symbol, m.profile, m.point, m.role FROM member m JOIN grade g ON m.grade_id = g.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND email = #{email}

SELECT m.id, m.name, m.gender, m.birthday, m.nickname, m.email, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.grade_id, g.name as grade_name, g.symbol as grade_symbol, m.profile, m.point, m.role FROM member m JOIN grade g ON m.grade_id = g.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY point ASC
ORDER BY point DESC

SELECT m.id, m.gender, m.nickname, m.grade_id, g.name as grade_name, g.symbol as grade_symbol, m.profile, m.point FROM member m JOIN grade g ON m.grade_id = g.id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY m.point desc
